paragraphs.text: The Darksteel Eye was an artifact used by Memnarch to monitor the entirety of events taking place across the plane of Mirrodin .

The Darksteel Eye was housed in the Panopticon . It was damaged during the release of the Green Sun , but later fully restored by Elesh Norn . The restored Eye cannot view Urabrask 's domain or Norn's sanctum in the Mycosynth Gardens.
